baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reciprocal form in يتنازعون governs كأسا, while two nominal negations qualify the shared scene.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mutual pulling is not merely conflict: its own branch explicitly includes exchanging a cup. Vessel and contents move as one social unit, while false or foul speech and the loading of guilt are excluded from the transfer.

activation_trace.role: The mutual-pulling branch literally includes cup exchange and makes reciprocity the social engine.
The cup-with-contents image makes vessel and drink one circulating unit.
The false-or-foul-speech image identifies the verbal corruption absent from the exchange.
The image of loading or charging sin makes the second negation remove blame-transfer between participants.

changed_reading.before: They contend over a cup, with bad side effects denied.
changed_reading.after: They actively pass and offer the cup among themselves; reciprocity remains lively while corrupt speech and interpersonal blame fail to travel with it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ن ز ع verb can carry inward attraction toward a desired object, here the cup.
baseline_models.mechanism: The scene can be appetitive rather than adversarial. Souls incline toward the drink, but desire neither ends in disappointment nor slows anyone from good; pleasure reaches its object without frustration or moral drag.

activation_trace.role: The yearning-toward-a-desired-object image turns the reciprocal verb into shared appetite.
The contained drink gives that attraction a concrete and reachable object.
The failure or disappointment image lets the first negation remove frustrated desire.
The lagging-from-good image lets the second negation remove the delay or drag usually attached to appetite.

changed_reading.before: The cup is an object fought over.
changed_reading.after: The cup draws all participants toward desired enjoyment, yet access neither fails nor diverts them from good.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus joins extraction, a cup-composite, what is discarded from account, and what is charged onto a person.
baseline_models.mechanism: Read materially and administratively, the drink is drawn out and transferred with no remainder written off and no liability loaded onto its recipient. The exchange leaves neither waste nor moral residue.

activation_trace.role: The pulling-out image supplies extraction of the drink from its place and initiates transfer.
The vessel-and-content composite supplies the bounded material being transferred.
The discarded-or-uncounted image makes its negation remove waste and write-off.
The loading-a-charge image makes its negation remove liability from the recipient.

changed_reading.before: The negatives promise only decent behavior while drinking.
changed_reading.after: The whole transfer is residue-free: nothing is discarded from value and no moral charge adheres to whoever receives the cup.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A ن ز ع branch names the pleasant finish of a drink as it is drawn away from the mouth.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verb may glance not only at passing the cup but at each drink's endpoint. Its finish is pleasant: no clamor emerges after drinking, and even the uncertain lexical association of ithm with wine is explicitly canceled.

activation_trace.role: The good-finish-of-a-drink image directly supplies a pleasant endpoint or aftertaste.
The cup and its drink make the finish branch locally concrete rather than free-floating.
The mixed clamor image identifies a noisy aftereffect that does not follow the drink.
The reported naming of wine as ithm lets the negation touch the drink-category itself, though the branch remains lexically uncertain.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes only the cup's movement among drinkers.
changed_reading.after: It also describes the drink's clean finish: pleasant at withdrawal from the mouth and barren of noisy or morally toxic aftermath.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same reciprocal branch genuinely includes contention as well as cup exchange, so the agonistic force need not be erased.
baseline_models.mechanism: A playful tug, eager rivalry, or verbal contest may remain. What disappears is not intensity but its conversion into false speech or accusatory guilt; the verse imagines competition that does not injure fellowship.

activation_trace.role: The reciprocal-contention image preserves real social tension rather than reducing the verb to neutral delivery.
The shared drink bounds the contest around a pleasurable common object.
The foul-speech image marks the harmful turn that the contest never takes.
The blame-loading image marks the social injury that reciprocal intensity does not produce.

changed_reading.before: Paradisal harmony requires all rivalry to vanish.
changed_reading.after: Eager contest can survive as harmless convivial play because neither verbal corruption nor blame is generated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier punitive scene uses a severe one-way push into fire; the focus uses a reciprocal pull around a cup. That directional reversal recasts the cup scene as restored agency: no party is mere object, and each both gives and receives.

activation_trace.role: The severe-pushing image supplies unilateral coercion as the scene's negative spatial foil.
The mutual-pulling image reverses that geometry into distributed agency around the cup.
The absent blame-load confirms that reciprocal handling does not recreate coercive injury.

structural_cues: 52:13 gives a passive plural a forced destination; 52:23 gives an active reciprocal plural a shared object.
Fire and cup occupy parallel destination-object positions but reverse agency and outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one-way severe pushing and later mutual pulling; I infer a deliberate reversal of agency. A live alternative is simple contrast between destinies without a shared motion schema.

changed_reading.before: The cup exchange is merely a pleasant action.
changed_reading.after: The cup exchange is an anti-coercive social form in which motion and agency are reciprocal rather than imposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to drink with ease and no ill effect activates the otherwise surprising pleasant-finish branch of ن ز ع. The two negations become the anatomy of hani'an: no noisy aftermath and no moral toxicity.

activation_trace.role: The literal taking of liquid confirms that the surrounding pleasure includes actual drinking.
The ease-without-hardship-or-ill-effect image supplies the drink's governing quality.
The pleasant-finish image localizes that ease at the drink's withdrawal and aftermath.
The negated clamor image specifies one ill effect excluded from the finish.

structural_cues: 52:19 explicitly commands drinking hani'an four ayat before the cup scene.
The focus's paired negations follow the drinking object rather than standing as a general paradise slogan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pleasant, harmless drinking and a branch for a drink's good finish; I infer that the latter specifies the former. Alternatively hani'an may characterize consumption globally, with no special aftertaste emphasis.

changed_reading.before: The good-finish branch is a vivid but isolated lexical possibility.
changed_reading.after: The prior promise of harmless, easy drinking makes the cup's clean finish a contextually supported reading.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pairing one being to another and making later descendants catch up activate the ن ز ع image of being drawn back to origin or stock. Passing the cup can therefore enact recovered belonging: reunited relations repeatedly draw the shared vessel toward one another.

activation_trace.role: The making-of-one-thing-as-counterpart-to-another image supplies deliberate social pairing.
The later-one-catching-up-to-what-is-ahead image supplies reunion across separation or sequence.
The being-drawn-back-to-origin-or-stock image anchors the reunion mechanism in the focus verb.
The common vessel and contents become the tangible token passed through the restored relation.

structural_cues: Pairing and descendant-attachment in 52:20-21 immediately precede provisioning and cup exchange.
The reciprocal plural in 52:23 allows every reunited party to draw and be drawn into the act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pairing, catching-up, and a focus branch for return to stock; I infer that cup exchange ritualizes reunion. The live alternative is that the stock image is merely etymic and the cup remains generic hospitality.

changed_reading.before: The drinkers are an already assembled anonymous group.
changed_reading.after: Their cup-passing can perform kinship restored after separation, repeatedly materializing their renewed attachment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context keeps personal deeds collateralized, yet also joins descendants without deduction, grants release without compensation, and rejects a burdensome liability. Against that ledger, the cup circulates as gift: nothing is written off as worthless, but no charge is attached to its recipient.

activation_trace.role: The document held against a right supplies the surrounding logic of individual collateral and accountability.
The release-without-compensation image supplies a contrasting economy of gratuitous benefit.
The binding financial liability image makes burdensome quid pro quo an explicit negative foil.
The discarded-or-uncounted image keeps the gift from becoming valueless or lost from account.
The absent loading of a charge prevents the received pleasure from becoming liability.

structural_cues: 52:21 juxtaposes personal pledge with attachment of descendants and no decrement of work.
52:27 names unbought release, while 52:40 frames burdensome liability as a rejected explanation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collateral, non-deduction, gratuitous release, and liability; I assign the cup to the gift side of that contrast. A live alternative is perfect settlement within a ledger rather than exemption from exchange-accounting.

changed_reading.before: No laghw and no ta'thim mean a perfectly clean transaction.
changed_reading.after: The cup is valuable yet non-debt-producing: it circulates as gratuitous abundance without erasing each person's separate moral account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision is extended as connected increase precisely toward what they desire. That pairing activates ن ز ع as yearning while removing scarcity from its reciprocal form: many can reach eagerly for the cup without anyone's desire failing another's.

activation_trace.role: The connected increase that supplies another with aid or material establishes replenishing abundance.
The soul's inclination toward what it desires directly echoes the appetitive focus branch.
The yearning image turns reciprocal reaching into convergent desire rather than hostile seizure.
The negated failure image ensures that shared appetite does not end in disappointed access.

structural_cues: 52:22 places extended provision and desire immediately before the cup.
The object changes from desired food in 52:22 to drink in 52:23 while the appetitive sequence continues.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies connected increase and desire; I infer that abundance prevents reciprocal desire from becoming scarcity-conflict. Alternatively the extension may denote variety rather than inexhaustibility.

changed_reading.before: Several drinkers reach for one scarce-looking cup.
changed_reading.after: Their simultaneous attraction indexes abundance: provision keeps extending, so eager reciprocity cannot deprive another.

context_deltas.mechanism: Circling attendants and a group turning toward one another place the cup inside a loop rather than a two-person handoff. Reciprocal drawing distributes service across a face-to-face assembly, while the negations prevent noise and blame from accumulating as the vessel moves.

activation_trace.role: The circling-around image supplies the larger service loop surrounding the cup exchange.
The group-facing-one-another image supplies a reciprocal social topology rather than a queue.
The mutual-pulling and cup-exchange image makes each participant a node in that circulation.
The vessel-with-contents image supplies the unit that travels around the loop.

structural_cues: 52:24 follows the focus with attendants circling around the same seated company.
52:25 then turns members of the company toward one another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies circular service and mutual facing; I infer a distributed circulation in which the cup links the assembly. Alternatively attendants alone circulate while the drinkers exchange locally.

changed_reading.before: The cup passes across a single reciprocal pair.
changed_reading.after: The cup traces a social circuit through a mutually facing assembly, repeatedly renewing relation as it moves.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the cup, mutual questioning opens into articulated recollection. Therefore no laghw cannot mean no speech: it means speech remains meaningful rather than false or noisy, and recollection proceeds without participants loading guilt onto one another.

activation_trace.role: The mutual-questioning image supplies explicitly reciprocal conversation after the cup scene.
The uttered-speech image supplies the answer and proves that audible language continues.
The false-or-foul-speech image narrows the negation from all talk to corrupted talk.
The absent blame-loading image allows shared memory without accusation among speakers.

structural_cues: 52:25-28 forms a question-answer-prayer sequence immediately after 52:23.
The focus negates qualities within the cup scene, not the capacity for speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies actual post-cup dialogue; I infer that it exemplifies the kind of speech left after laghw and blame are removed. Alternatively the later conversation may be temporally separate from drinking.

changed_reading.before: No laghw suggests quiet decorum or an absence of conversation.
changed_reading.after: The gathering is verbally active: questions and testimony circulate, but words neither collapse into false noise nor weaponize remembered fear as blame.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later discourse repeatedly attributes invented speech and is challenged to produce a comparable utterance truthfully. This sharpens the focus pair: laghw is counterfeit saying, while ta'thim is the guilt such attribution attempts to fasten onto another.

activation_trace.role: The saying-or-attributing-what-never-was image supplies counterfeit attribution as the polemical speech failure.
The speech-renewed-as-report image supplies the demanded positive discourse object.
The truth-of-speech image supplies the criterion that separates meaningful report from fabrication.
The false-speech image anchors counterfeit discourse in the focus negation.
The charging-sin image explains fabricated attribution as an attempt to load culpability onto its target.

structural_cues: 52:29-44 is densely organized around labels, claims, challenges, evidence, and misdescription.
52:33-34 places fabricated attribution directly against truthful production of discourse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false attribution and a truth-conditioned speech challenge; I infer that these expose the absent mechanism named in 52:23. Alternatively the later polemic concerns revelation only and need not define banquet speech.

changed_reading.before: Laghw is merely idle or indecent table talk, and ta'thim merely intoxication's moral consequence.
changed_reading.after: The pair also excludes a whole accusatory speech mechanism: invent a saying, attribute it to another, then make that person bear its guilt.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it scales a cosmic water-image down into tableware. It remains anchored in the focus cup and the hand-drawn-water branch of ن ز ع, with the earlier filled sea supplying a material analogue; render only as a scale-changing image, not as a claim that the cup literally is the sea.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The cup is a bounded vessel-and-content unit, and the focus verb has a branch for water drawn directly by hand.

activation_trace.role: The vast abundant-water image supplies the scene's maximal liquid reservoir.
The being-filled-with-water image makes that reservoir materially replete.
The hand-drawn-water image scales abundance into an intimate act of direct drawing.
The vessel-with-contents image gives the vast liquid a finite shareable boundary.

changed_reading.before: The cup is ordinary banquet equipment.
changed_reading.after: The cup can image cosmic abundance made graspable: a hand-drawn, bounded share of the earlier replete expanse.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a bowstring is form-distant from drinking. It remains anchored in a live focus branch and gains spatial support from the aligned couches; render as a kinesthetic analogy for held and released social tension, never as a lexical replacement for cup exchange.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reciprocal verb retains the ن ز ع branch of drawing a bowstring, while the object remains the cup.

activation_trace.role: The alignment-on-a-level-line image supplies ordered endpoints across the seated company.
The drawn-bowstring image supplies tension held between opposed pulls and released into motion.
The cup-with-drink image keeps that tension attached to convivial handling rather than weaponry.
The absent guilt-load prevents released tension from landing as injury or accusation.

changed_reading.after: Across the aligned gathering, cup exchange repeatedly draws and releases relational tension without turning that stored energy into harm.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines well-drawing, replenishing water, and circular motion into a hydraulic model. It remains anchored in the cup and an explicit water-drawing focus branch, with immediate extension and circling cues; render as a material analogy for inexhaustible circulation, not hidden plumbing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins a hand-drawing branch of ن ز ع to a vessel that includes its liquid contents.

activation_trace.role: The water-replenished-by-other-water image supplies continued inflow to the provision.
The circling image bends linear supply into a recurring service loop.
The hand-drawn-water image supplies extraction at each act of drinking.
The vessel-and-liquid composite is the moving chamber of the inferred loop.
The negated failure image marks the circuit as nonstalling rather than exhaustible.

changed_reading.before: A finite cup is repeatedly passed.
changed_reading.after: Each drawing participates in a replenished circuit: the cup moves, empties, refills, and never reaches failure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it extends laghw from bad talk into perceptual classification. It remains anchored in the focus branch for deviation from correctness and is activated by the later sight-to-conjectural-label sequence; render as an epistemic extension of purified speech, not as the primary sense of laghw.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The negated ل غ و has a branch for turning away from correctness, adjacent to the negation of loading guilt.

activation_trace.role: The seeing-by-eye-and-insight image supplies the perceptual input that can be handled rightly or wrongly.
The detached-piece image supplies what is actually presented to sight.
The saying-that-runs-as-conjecture image supplies the mistaken verbal classification of what is seen.
The deviation-from-correctness image lets the focus negate that slide from perception into a false label.
The absent guilt-load prevents a mistaken label from becoming an accusation attached to another.

changed_reading.before: No laghw means no idle or obscene speech.
changed_reading.after: Speech in the cup scene may also be epistemically clean: perception is not bent into a convenient false name, then converted into blame.

strongest_changes: The reciprocal verb remains bifocal: it can be idiomatic cup-passing or real playful contention detoxified by the two negations.
The push-to-pull reversal makes the scene a restoration of reciprocal agency rather than pleasure alone.
Extended desired provision, social reunion, circular service, and post-cup dialogue turn the cup into an abundant relational circuit.
Collateral, gratuitous release, and burdensome liability revise the negatives into a gift economy: value remains, debt does not attach.
The later fabrication challenge changes no-laghw from mere table decorum into protection against counterfeit attribution and blame-loading.
summary.what_was_special: One focus inventory simultaneously supplied literal cup exchange, contention, yearning, return to stock, hand-drawn water, bow tension, and a pleasant drink-finish. The surrounding sequence activated several of these into causal models without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether B006 neutralizes contention into idiomatic passing or preserves a real playful contest remains genuinely open.
The pleasant-finish reading is unusually exact but may be a lexical echo rather than the verb's operative sense here.
The accounting cues can support either release from transactional liability or perfectly settled accounting.
The sea, bowstring, hydraulic, and perceptual models are anchored analogies and should not be promoted to unqualified lexical glosses.
